svg.title: Moat Court: a map for 4 kings and their peasants
svg.desc: The four kings hold moated islands in the middle, each with two bridges out to its corner and one in to the Crown Isle, where all four meet. Their peasants hold the corners. A cliff in the middle of each edge parts two teams' peasants, with contested metal in front of it.
svg.text: 4 kings, 3 peasants each · 24 × 24 map (12288 game units square) · 4 teams of 4, 16 players
The four kings hold moated islands in the middle, each with two bridges out to its corner and one in
to the Crown Isle, where all four meet. Their peasants hold the corners. A cliff in the middle of each
edge parts two teams' peasants, with contested metal in front of it.
Heights: corners 240 · moat and canals 60 deep · keep islands 280 · the Crown Isle 300
Planet Bayou · a fog-bound swamp world
Ground: olive mud and reed beds, dark peat at the water's edge, mossy stone on the keep islands,
Plants: oaktree_c and kapoktree as swamp cypress, ferns as reeds along the moat, orangemushrooms on
Features: rocks30_moss on the edge cliffs, sunken corssub_dead and corpt_dead hulks in the moat,
crateblue and cratered stacked at the bridges.
Sky and weather: thick grey-green fog, little sun; wind 0 to 8; tidal 18.
Each quarter is the same, turned 90° about the centre. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
